articles.summary: Across the Netherlands, electric vehicle (EV) adoption is moving from early growth to mainstream. For energy retailers, that shift is changing what customers expect from their energy provider. What began as EV-specific tariffs is evolving into offers that include a home charger, app-based smart charging, and flexibility programs designed to optimize renewable energy use and support grid stability. Now, EV charging optimization is becoming part of the core energy proposition, not an add-on. As expectations rise, EV charging needs to be reliable, easy to manage in the same app customers already use for their energy management, and delivered as part of a cohesive customer experience. That is why we are partnering with Peblar.
articles.title: Peblar x Enode: Expanding EV charger choices for energy retailers

articles.summary: Energy retailers are moving from experimentation to long-term decisions about residential flexibility. Today, flexibility needs to operate as part of day-to-day business, not as a side initiative. SAP sees that shift clearly. That’s why SAP has chosen Enode to enable SAP Distributed Energy Resources, a solution supporting residential distributed energy resource (DER) flexibility within SAP environments. The partnership brings Enode’s full product capabilities into the SAP ecosystem, allowing utilities to manage residential flexibility with the same operational discipline they apply to the rest of their business.
articles.title: Enode x SAP: SAP has chosen Enode to enable residential flexibility within SAP Distributed Energy Resources

articles.summary: ENGIE, a global energy player serving 19 million residential contracts worldwide, is partnering with Enode to scale residential flexibility for its energy retail portfolio in Belgium, France and the Netherlands. As electrification accelerates and more customers adopt electrical vehicles (EVs), home chargers, and other home energy technologies, consumer flexibility is becoming a strategic lever to both improve the customer proposition and unlock new operational value. This partnership reflects a broader shift across European energy retail. Consumer flexibility is becoming a core capability, not an experiment, and requires platforms built for reliability, governance, and growth.
articles.title: Enode selected by ENGIE to scale residential EV flexibility
